title: IFMIF-DONES 融合材料中子源
subcategoryTitle: 核融合：工程系統與其他路線
subcategoryTitleEn: Fusion: engineering systems and other approaches
summary: IFMIF-DONES 位於西班牙格拉納達省的埃斯庫薩爾，2023 年進入建造階段，將以 40 MeV、125 mA 的氘束打在高速流動的液態鋰上產生與融合相似能譜的中子，為示範電廠的結構材料累積照射數據；課程定量分析束功率與功率密度、鋰的溫升、離心力對鋰的增壓、損傷累積的時間與設施的可用率。
summaryEn: IFMIF-DONES at Escúzar in Granada province, Spain, entered its construction phase in 2023 and will fire a 40 MeV, 125 mA deuteron beam at fast-flowing liquid lithium to make neutrons with a fusion-like spectrum, building irradiation data on structural materials for a demonstration plant; the course quantifies beam power and power density, lithium temperature rise, pressurisation of lithium by centrifugal force, time to accumulate damage and facility availability.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 以加速器模擬融合中子：五百萬瓦氘束、液態鋰靶、材料損傷累積與可用率
v30FocusEn: Simulating fusion neutrons with an accelerator: a five-megawatt deuteron beam, a liquid-lithium target, accumulating material damage and availability

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：IFMIF-DONES 融合材料中子源
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: IFMIF-DONES Fusion Materials Neutron Source
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「五百萬瓦的氘束」與「束斑上的功率密度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "A five-megawatt deuteron beam" and "Power density in the beam footprint": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「五百萬瓦的氘束」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "A five-megawatt deuteron beam" is correct?
options: 氘氚融合放出的中子能量高達 14 百萬電子伏特，會在鋼材裡撞出大量的氦與氫，這是分裂反應爐的中子做不到的；要知道材料在融合電廠裡能撐多久，就必須有能量相近的中子源。
加速器只是實驗物理的工具，和能源工程無關。
功率只要不大，集中在哪裡都沒關係。
optionsEn: Deuterium-tritium fusion neutrons carry 14 million electron-volts and knock much helium and hydrogen into steel, which fission-reactor neutrons cannot do.
An accelerator is a tool of experimental physics with no bearing on energy engineering.
As long as power is modest, it does not matter where it is concentrated.
quiz.explanation: 氘氚融合放出的中子能量高達 14 百萬電子伏特，會在鋼材裡撞出大量的氦與氫，這是分裂反應爐的中子做不到的；要知道材料在融合電廠裡能撐多久，就必須有能量相近的中子源。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Deuterium-tritium fusion neutrons carry 14 million electron-volts and knock much helium and hydrogen into steel, which fission-reactor neutrons cannot do; to learn how long a material lasts in a fusion plant a neutron source of similar energy is needed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 五百萬瓦的氘束：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: A five-megawatt deuteron beam: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「五百萬瓦的氘束」如何決定「IFMIF-DONES 融合材料中子源」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “A five-megawatt deuteron beam” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “IFMIF-DONES Fusion Materials Neutron Source”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 氘氚融合放出的中子能量高達 14 百萬電子伏特，會在鋼材裡撞出大量的氦與氫，這是分裂反應爐的中子做不到的；要知道材料在融合電廠裡能撐多久，就必須有能量相近的中子源。DONES 的做法是用直線加速器把氘原子核加速到 40 百萬電子伏特，打進鋰裡發生剝離反應，向前噴出一束中子。束的功率等於每個粒子的能量乘以每秒的粒子數，也就是加速電壓乘以電流——五百萬瓦的連續束流是強流加速器技術的極限。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Deuterium-tritium fusion neutrons carry 14 million electron-volts and knock much helium and hydrogen into steel, which fission-reactor neutrons cannot do; to learn how long a material lasts in a fusion plant a neutron source of similar energy is needed. DONES accelerates deuterons to 40 million electron-volts in a linear accelerator and drives them into lithium, where stripping reactions throw a beam of neutrons forward. Beam power is energy per particle times particles per second, that is accelerating voltage times current, and five megawatts of continuous beam is at the limit of high-current accelerator technology. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：氘束能量 40 MeV、電流 125 mA，連續運轉
steps.observationEn: Project file: The deuteron beam is 40 MeV and 125 mA in continuous operation
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「加速器只是實驗物理的工具，和能源工程無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An accelerator is a tool of experimental physics with no bearing on energy engineering." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「五百萬瓦的氘束」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “A five-megawatt deuteron beam”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 依「五百萬瓦的氘束」的模型 P = U·I，等效加速電壓 40 MV、束電流 0.125 A 時的束功率最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model P = U·I for "A five-megawatt deuteron beam", which value is closest to the beam power at an equivalent accelerating voltage of 40 MV and a current of 0.125 A?
options: 5.0 MW
optionsEn: 5.0 MW
quiz.explanation: P = U·I；代入 U = 40 MV、I = 0.125 A，得 5.0 MW（等效加速電壓 40 MV、束電流 0.125 A 時的束功率）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: P = U·I; with U = 40 MV, I = 0.125 A the result is 5.0 MW (beam power at an equivalent accelerating voltage of 40 MV and a current of 0.125 A). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 五百萬瓦的氘束：定量估算
steps.titleEn: A five-megawatt deuteron beam: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「五百萬瓦的氘束」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “A five-megawatt deuteron beam” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：P = U·I；代入 U = 40 MV、I = 0.125 A，得 5.0 MW（等效加速電壓 40 MV、束電流 0.125 A 時的束功率）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 I 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: P = U·I; with U = 40 MV, I = 0.125 A the result is 5.0 MW (beam power at an equivalent accelerating voltage of 40 MV and a current of 0.125 A). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise I by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：I 增加 10% 時，結果變為 5.5 MW（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising I by 10% changes the result to 5.5 MW (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 5.0 MW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 I 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 5.0 MW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in I with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: P = U·I；代入 U = 40 MV、I = 0.125 A，得 5.0 MW（等效加速電壓 40 MV、束電流 0.125 A 時的束功率）。
knowledge.textEn: P = U·I; with U = 40 MV, I = 0.125 A the result is 5.0 MW (beam power at an equivalent accelerating voltage of 40 MV and a current of 0.125 A).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: I 增加 10% 時，結果變為 5.5 MW（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising I by 10% changes the result to 5.5 MW (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「五百萬瓦的氘束」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "A five-megawatt deuteron beam"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
真空只要用夠大的泵抽久一點就會變好。
以束流變壓器量測電流、飛行時間法量測能量，並以沿束線分布的束損偵測器確認每公尺的損失低於允許值。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Vacuum simply improves if a big enough pump runs long enough.
Beam current transformers measure current, time-of-flight measures energy, and loss monitors along the line confirm losses per metre below the allowed value.
quiz.explanation: 以束流變壓器量測電流、飛行時間法量測能量，並以沿束線分布的束損偵測器確認每公尺的損失低於允許值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Beam current transformers measure current, time-of-flight measures energy, and loss monitors along the line confirm losses per metre below the allowed value. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 五百萬瓦的氘束：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: A five-megawatt deuteron beam: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「五百萬瓦的氘束」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “A five-megawatt deuteron beam” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以束流變壓器量測電流、飛行時間法量測能量，並以沿束線分布的束損偵測器確認每公尺的損失低於允許值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Beam current transformers measure current, time-of-flight measures energy, and loss monitors along the line confirm losses per metre below the allowed value. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：強流加速器要以束損作為首要的設計與運轉限制，並備有毫秒級的機器保護系統。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make beam loss the leading design and operating limit of a high-current accelerator, with a machine protection system acting in milliseconds.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：強流束的空間電荷力使束暈擴大，少量粒子打在束管上；每公尺損失一瓦就足以使結構活化到無法人工維修。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Space-charge force in a high-current beam grows a halo, and a few particles strike the beam pipe; a watt lost per metre is enough to activate structures beyond hands-on maintenance. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以束流變壓器量測電流、飛行時間法量測能量，並以沿束線分布的束損偵測器確認每公尺的損失低於允許值。
knowledge.textEn: Beam current transformers measure current, time-of-flight measures energy, and loss monitors along the line confirm losses per metre below the allowed value.

knowledge.textEn: Make beam loss the leading design and operating limit of a high-current accelerator, with a machine protection system acting in milliseconds.

quiz.question: 在「五百萬瓦的氘束」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "A five-megawatt deuteron beam" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 強流束的空間電荷力使束暈擴大，少量粒子打在束管上；每公尺損失一瓦就足以使結構活化到無法人工維修。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
功率只要不大，集中在哪裡都沒關係。
optionsEn: Space-charge force in a high-current beam grows a halo, and a few particles strike the beam pipe.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
As long as power is modest, it does not matter where it is concentrated.
quiz.explanation: 強流束的空間電荷力使束暈擴大，少量粒子打在束管上；每公尺損失一瓦就足以使結構活化到無法人工維修。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Space-charge force in a high-current beam grows a halo, and a few particles strike the beam pipe; a watt lost per metre is enough to activate structures beyond hands-on maintenance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 五百萬瓦的氘束：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: A five-megawatt deuteron beam: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「五百萬瓦的氘束」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “A five-megawatt deuteron beam” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 強流束的空間電荷力使束暈擴大，少量粒子打在束管上；每公尺損失一瓦就足以使結構活化到無法人工維修。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「IFMIF-DONES 融合材料中子源」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Space-charge force in a high-current beam grows a halo, and a few particles strike the beam pipe; a watt lost per metre is enough to activate structures beyond hands-on maintenance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “IFMIF-DONES Fusion Materials Neutron Source”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：束的功率等於每個粒子的能量乘以每秒的粒子數，也就是加速電壓乘以電流——五百萬瓦的連續束流是強流加速器技術的極限。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Beam power is energy per particle times particles per second, that is accelerating voltage times current, and five megawatts of continuous beam is at the limit of high-current accelerator technology.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「加速器只是實驗物理的工具，和能源工程無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An accelerator is a tool of experimental physics with no bearing on energy engineering." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 強流束的空間電荷力使束暈擴大，少量粒子打在束管上；每公尺損失一瓦就足以使結構活化到無法人工維修。
knowledge.textEn: Space-charge force in a high-current beam grows a halo, and a few particles strike the beam pipe; a watt lost per metre is enough to activate structures beyond hands-on maintenance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 關於「束斑上的功率密度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Power density in the beam footprint" is correct?
options: 功率只要不大，集中在哪裡都沒關係。
液態金屬的導熱很好，所以不流動也能把熱帶走。
五百萬瓦並不算特別大，困難在於它集中在一個手掌大的面積上，而且全部沉積在兩公分厚的鋰裡。
optionsEn: As long as power is modest, it does not matter where it is concentrated.
Liquid metal conducts heat so well that it removes heat even without flowing.
Five megawatts is not especially large; the difficulty is that it lands on an area the size of a hand and all stops within two centimetres of lithium.
quiz.explanation: 五百萬瓦並不算特別大，困難在於它集中在一個手掌大的面積上，而且全部沉積在兩公分厚的鋰裡。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Five megawatts is not especially large; the difficulty is that it lands on an area the size of a hand and all stops within two centimetres of lithium. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 束斑上的功率密度：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Power density in the beam footprint: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「束斑上的功率密度」如何決定「IFMIF-DONES 融合材料中子源」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Power density in the beam footprint” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “IFMIF-DONES Fusion Materials Neutron Source”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 五百萬瓦並不算特別大，困難在於它集中在一個手掌大的面積上，而且全部沉積在兩公分厚的鋰裡。平均功率密度高達每平方公尺數億瓦，沒有任何固體靶能承受——它會在瞬間熔化。唯一的辦法是讓靶自己流動：液態鋰以每秒十幾公尺的速度流過束斑，每一小塊鋰只在束裡停留千分之幾秒，還來不及升溫太多就被帶走，把熱送到下游的熱交換器。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Five megawatts is not especially large; the difficulty is that it lands on an area the size of a hand and all stops within two centimetres of lithium. Mean power density reaches hundreds of megawatts per square metre, which no solid target can bear without melting at once. The only way is a target that flows: liquid lithium crosses the footprint at well over ten metres a second, each parcel spends a few thousandths of a second in the beam and is carried off before warming much, taking heat to an exchanger downstream. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：液態鋰靶厚約 25 mm，流速約每秒 15 m
steps.observationEn: Project file: The liquid-lithium target is about 25 mm thick and flows at about 15 m/s
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「功率只要不大，集中在哪裡都沒關係。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as power is modest, it does not matter where it is concentrated." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「束斑上的功率密度」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Power density in the beam footprint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Five megawatts is not especially large; the difficulty is that it lands on an area the size of a hand and all stops within two centimetres of lithium. Mean power density reaches hundreds of megawatts per square metre, which no solid target can bear without melting at once. The only way is a target that flows: liquid lithium crosses the footprint at well over ten metres a second, each parcel spends a few thousandths of a second in the beam and is carried off before warming much, taking heat to an exchanger downstream.

knowledge.text: 誤解：功率只要不大，集中在哪裡都沒關係。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 依「束斑上的功率密度」的模型 q = P / (w·h)，5 MW 的束功率落在寬 0.2 m、高 0.05 m 的束斑上時的平均功率密度最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model q = P / (w·h) for "Power density in the beam footprint", which value is closest to the mean power density when 5 MW falls on a footprint 0.2 m wide and 0.05 m high?
options: 500 MW/m²
5,000 MW/m²
250 MW/m²
optionsEn: 500 MW/m²
5,000 MW/m²
250 MW/m²
quiz.explanation: q = P / (w·h)；代入 P = 5 MW、w = 0.2 m、h = 0.05 m，得 500 MW/m²（5 MW 的束功率落在寬 0.2 m、高 0.05 m 的束斑上時的平均功率密度）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: q = P / (w·h); with P = 5 MW, w = 0.2 m, h = 0.05 m the result is 500 MW/m² (mean power density when 5 MW falls on a footprint 0.2 m wide and 0.05 m high). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 束斑上的功率密度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Power density in the beam footprint: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「束斑上的功率密度」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Power density in the beam footprint” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：q = P / (w·h)；代入 P = 5 MW、w = 0.2 m、h = 0.05 m，得 500 MW/m²（5 MW 的束功率落在寬 0.2 m、高 0.05 m 的束斑上時的平均功率密度）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 h 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: q = P / (w·h); with P = 5 MW, w = 0.2 m, h = 0.05 m the result is 500 MW/m² (mean power density when 5 MW falls on a footprint 0.2 m wide and 0.05 m high). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise h by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：h 增加 10% 時，結果變為 455 MW/m²（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising h by 10% changes the result to 455 MW/m² (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 500 MW/m²（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 h 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 500 MW/m² (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in h with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: q = P / (w·h)；代入 P = 5 MW、w = 0.2 m、h = 0.05 m，得 500 MW/m²（5 MW 的束功率落在寬 0.2 m、高 0.05 m 的束斑上時的平均功率密度）。
knowledge.textEn: q = P / (w·h); with P = 5 MW, w = 0.2 m, h = 0.05 m the result is 500 MW/m² (mean power density when 5 MW falls on a footprint 0.2 m wide and 0.05 m high).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: h 增加 10% 時，結果變為 455 MW/m²（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising h by 10% changes the result to 455 MW/m² (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「束斑上的功率密度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Power density in the beam footprint"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以束流剖面監測器確認束斑的形狀與均勻度，並以紅外線與干涉儀量測鋰自由表面的溫度與波動。
材料在分裂反應爐裡測試過，就可以直接用在融合電廠。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Profile monitors confirm shape and uniformity of the footprint, and infrared and interferometry measure temperature and waviness of the lithium free surface.
A material tested in a fission reactor can go straight into a fusion plant.
quiz.explanation: 以束流剖面監測器確認束斑的形狀與均勻度，並以紅外線與干涉儀量測鋰自由表面的溫度與波動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Profile monitors confirm shape and uniformity of the footprint, and infrared and interferometry measure temperature and waviness of the lithium free surface. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 束斑上的功率密度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Power density in the beam footprint: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「束斑上的功率密度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Power density in the beam footprint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以束流剖面監測器確認束斑的形狀與均勻度，並以紅外線與干涉儀量測鋰自由表面的溫度與波動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Profile monitors confirm shape and uniformity of the footprint, and infrared and interferometry measure temperature and waviness of the lithium free surface. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：束斑位置與尺寸要有即時量測與連鎖，偏離允許範圍時在幾十微秒內切斷束流。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Measure footprint position and size in real time with an interlock cutting the beam within tens of microseconds when outside the allowed band.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：束斑若偏移或聚得太小，局部功率密度超過鋰流所能帶走的極限，鋰沸騰並損壞後方的背板。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A footprint displaced or focused too tightly takes local power density beyond what the flow can carry, boiling the lithium and damaging the backplate behind it. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Profile monitors confirm shape and uniformity of the footprint, and infrared and interferometry measure temperature and waviness of the lithium free surface.

optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.

steps.title: 束斑上的功率密度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Power density in the beam footprint: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「束斑上的功率密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Power density in the beam footprint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 束斑若偏移或聚得太小，局部功率密度超過鋰流所能帶走的極限，鋰沸騰並損壞後方的背板。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「IFMIF-DONES 融合材料中子源」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: A footprint displaced or focused too tightly takes local power density beyond what the flow can carry, boiling the lithium and damaging the backplate behind it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “IFMIF-DONES Fusion Materials Neutron Source”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：唯一的辦法是讓靶自己流動：液態鋰以每秒十幾公尺的速度流過束斑，每一小塊鋰只在束裡停留千分之幾秒，還來不及升溫太多就被帶走，把熱送到下游的熱交換器。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The only way is a target that flows: liquid lithium crosses the footprint at well over ten metres a second, each parcel spends a few thousandths of a second in the beam and is carried off before warming much, taking heat to an exchanger downstream.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「功率只要不大，集中在哪裡都沒關係。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as power is modest, it does not matter where it is concentrated." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: A footprint displaced or focused too tightly takes local power density beyond what the flow can carry, boiling the lithium and damaging the backplate behind it.
